title: CIRSEC Baselines - Microsoft Graph API check spec

resource.description: Resource path, e.g. /policies/authorizationPolicy. GET for the check, PATCH for the fix.

property.description: Dotted path of the property in the response, e.g. defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateApps.

operator.description: How the observed value compares to value. match = regex.

value.description: Expected value. May be a single {{ parameter }}, resolved with its type.
